column1: # derivation: §9.1, §9.7: ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING, by id.
# §9.10: FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE respect NULLs: the value of the frame's
# first and last row, NULL when that row's v is NULL. g = 1 (v 3, NULL, 5,
# 1, 4): id 1 {3, NULL}: 3, NULL; id 2 {3, NULL, 5}: 3, 5; id 3 {NULL, 5,
# A frame stays within the current row's partition: standard SQL window
# semantics, which no item states yet.
# Types: id, g, v, w, u keep their scanned types; FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE
# have v's type, INT64, nullable because v is nullable (§8.25).
